features.feature: Sidebar of internal/external disks and volumes
Show Only Volumes / Show All Devices
features.apple: View > Show Only Volumes, Show All Devices
features.note: View menu radio items (cmd+1, cmd+2) in main.rs; volume_indices() drives the volumes-only sidebar. Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add View radio items in main.rs and a flag in window.rs sidebar() that hides Kind::Disk rows when volumes-only.

features.feature: Volume info: capacity, used, free, fs, mount point, SMART

features.note: Get Info (cmd+I) is a sheet, not a separate window, and now lists UUID, partition map, serial number and block size from the udev database and sysfs. Not every lsblk -O field is read. Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add File > Get Info (cmd+I) opening a window listing all lsblk -O fields for the node.

features.note: File menu items with cmd+M, cmd+U, cmd+E mirror the toolbar.
features.wire: Mirror Mount/Unmount/Eject into a File menu in main.rs main_menu.

features.feature: Erase with name, format and scheme
features.note: The Erase sheet has a Name field (Tab and Return work); the Disk menu offers ext4, exFAT, FAT32, NTFS and Btrfs (springboard/core/src/disk_format.rs). The format is a Disk menu choice, not a popup in the sheet, and there is no MBR scheme choice yet (the helper writes GPT only). Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Extend the erase sheet with a Name text field, Format popup (ext4, exFAT, FAT32, NTFS, btrfs) and Scheme popup (GPT/MBR) for disks, feeding DiskRequest::EraseDisk fs/label.

features.note: Check Only and Repair via privd; no streamed log details.

Disk > Partition and a toolbar button open a sheet where the size of each partition is typed (64 GB, 25%, rest); equal parts stay in the menu. No draggable bar to resize and no resize of an existing partition in place. Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add a Partition sheet with a bar of partitions, add/remove/resize, then a privd DiskRequest::Partition (sgdisk) in bifrost-core and a toolbar button in window.rs:326.

features.note: Disk > Restore copies an unmounted volume or disk onto another of the same kind and at least the same size through disk.restore_volume (dd in the helper, springboard/core/src/disk_format.rs:restore_volume). No image source, no progress percentage and no Scan Image For Restore.
features.wire: Add a Restore sheet picking source volume or image; privd request running dd/partclone with progress.

features.note: Disk > Rename opens a Name sheet and sends disk.rename_volume (e2label, fatlabel, exfatlabel, ntfslabel, btrfs filesystem label). Unmounted volumes only; no inline rename in the sidebar.
features.wire: Inline rename in the sidebar or a sheet; privd request using e2label/fatlabel/exfatlabel.

features.feature: Create image (blank, from folder, from device)
features.note: File > New Blank Image (cmd+N) asks for a name and size, saves the image in Documents, formats it with the Disk menu format and opens it. No save panel for the location, no image from a folder or from a device.
features.wire: Add File > New Image submenu: blank image via truncate+mkfs, from folder via mkfs -d / mksquashfs, from device via dd, with a save panel (CreateDiskImageAccessory equivalent).

features.note: File > Open Disk Image (cmd+O) uses the open panel and attaches the chosen file read-only through hdiutil; the path is read back from the open file descriptor. Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add File > Open Disk Image... using the SDK open panel and a losetup -P attach through disk_session.

features.apple: Images > Convert, Resize, Scan Image For Restore; File > Change Password
features.note: Images > Convert to qcow2 and Convert to Raw write a copy next to the selected image with qemu-img. No Resize, no Scan Image For Restore and no Change Password (needs a password field and a LUKS request).
features.wire: Images menu with Convert (qemu-img convert), Resize (truncate + resize2fs); LUKS change password via cryptsetup through privd.

features.note: Tied to the platform container file system; btrfs subvolumes would be the analogue, not planned.
Not done: needs an mdadm request in the disk helper.
features.wire: mdadm-based RAID assistant window: choose type, members, create; privd request.

features.note: File > Show in Files (cmd+shift+R) opens the mount point as a file:// URL via ctx.open_url (actions::mount_url, tested). Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add a menu item opening the selected mount point in the Files app via shell open.
